method: seed i (i = 0, 1, …) is lo + (first 8 bytes of SHA-256(label + "/" + i), big-endian) mod (hi − lo + 1); skip repeats and excluded sets; stop at count
label: dreamteam/v0.2/eval-holdout-1
protocol: The seeds are not listed anywhere in the repository; they are regenerated from this method and must match seedsSHA256.

No harness runs a holdout seed until docs/evaluation/holdout-unseal.json is committed, naming this holdout, the policy's SHA-256 and the SHA-256 of the frozen strategy set, with the owner's approval. eval.GuardSeeds enforces it.

Before unsealing: the strategies are frozen from development seeds 901-910 only (1001-1020 are exposed and reference-only), the policy is confirmed by the owner and audited, and the strategy set's files are committed.
The holdout is run once, every frozen strategy and the no-action baseline on all 40 seeds, and evaluated with the frozen policy. The report and records are committed as they come out.

A rerun is allowed only to reproduce the same bytes (same engine, policy, strategies). Any change to a strategy, the policy or the engine after unsealing makes the holdout exposed: its results become reference-only, and a new holdout must be generated with a new label.
